phases.title: Pull request flow and dry run
API function, routes and Cognito authorizer

admin_actions: Create SSM String params (us-east-2) /config/cognito/staff/user-pool-id, /config/cognito/staff/auth-domain, /config/cognito/staff/class-photo-app-client-id before the PR reaches stage.
Redeploy deploy role stack AsmblyFacilitiesMaintTrackingStack-cicd before the PR reaches stage.
Create Cognito app client class-photo-upload in the AsmblyMCPs staff pool (public, PKCE code grant, openid; callback/sign-out URLs for prod and stage).
GitHub org owner: create GitHub App 'Asmbly Class Photos' (Contents RW, Pull requests RW, Metadata R; webhook off; this account only), install on asmbly-classes only, generate private key.
Store Secrets Manager secret github/class-photo-upload-app (us-east-2) as JSON {app_id, installation_id, private_key}.
Optional: create epic/story labels and apply to #73 and #104-#109.

events.detail: Session requires developing and pushing on claude/inspiring-bell-o4i5t9; used it instead of feature/class-photo-upload. Owner may rename.
gh CLI not available in this environment; GitHub operations go through the GitHub MCP tools.
sam CLI was not preinstalled; installed aws-sam-cli 1.169.0 into a scratch venv (not committed). sam validate passes on stage baseline.

Plan commit 060129e; stories #104-#109 as sub-issues of #73; 24 decisions. Decision 7: GET /class-photo-upload page shell has no authorizer (browser navigation can't carry a token); data routes use Cognito authorizer.
Phase subagents have no Agent tool, so /prep, /build and /review ran their sub-reviews inline. The orchestrator adds an independent review-lead pass per phase.
superseded_images compares extensions case-sensitively (Vite glob ignores .JPG); collision warning plural form; NeonCRMError raised from None.
Stories #104-#109 lack the story label (label doesn't exist; MCP can't create labels); prep's label rule not treated as a blocker.

Location data = GPS coordinates (EXIF GPS IFD in IFD0/IFD1/Exif sub-IFD, XMP GPS, in the primary image and up to 16 embedded images/trailers). Reverse-geocoded place names (IPTC City, XMP photoshop:City, LocationCreated) are not checked: owner may want to widen. README Decisions 25-26.
4 MB = 4 x 1024 x 1024 bytes; 3:2 rule integer 100*|2w-3h| <= 3h (1% tolerance).
Valid-but-rare JPEGs (bytes between segments, DNL height 0, malformed EXIF APP1) are refused as unreadable; note in manual QA.

PyJWT[crypto]==2.15.1 pinned (newest 2.x >= 2 weeks old); function requirements must pin the same. Installation tokens always scoped to one repo + explicit permissions. Branch prefix must end with '/'; GitHubConflict only from create_branch/update_branch/create_pull_request.
cryptography is unpinned transitively (same practice as slack-sdk).

Tree and PR description always computed from current main. Repeat upload with open PR: fast-forward commit, second parent = main only if main moved (Decision 27). Branch exists without open PR (merged/closed): force-reset class-photo/ branch onto main and open a new PR; old PR never reopened.
User-derived text in PR body in CommonMark-safe code spans; '#'/'@' neutralized in PR title and commit message so a class name can't reference/close issues or mention users.
Known limit: two simultaneous submissions for the same class racing a force-reset can leave the other's description; the loser gets a conflict error.

events.detail: Time budget: Neon 4 s x max 8 pages, GitHub 5 s per call, Lambda timeout 25 s; no prod write starts with <8 s left. CLASS_PHOTO_DRY_RUN = !If [IsProd,'false','true'] (fails safe). Handler checks aud (compare_digest) + token_use=id before any secret/Neon read. Oversize base64 refused before decode.

Added cognito-idp:DescribeUserPool on the exact staff pool ARN to the deploy role as a precaution (couldn't verify offline whether API Gateway needs it). Consider dropping after the first successful stage deploy.
